text:
[LDEB.6.4.1] Replay and branching rely on the foundational determinism
guarantee in [LDET]: given the same
event trace and rule set, the same observable outcomes are
produced, bit-for-bit. The debugger exploits this to trust
that stepping backwards shows the same state the author saw
going forwards, and that forking from an instant under
modified inputs diverges only because of the modification.
